body.says: Where one stands, said by what it means, and a search of the field from there: the holons that say the words, their types and groupings, and what can be done here, each a press that rises to the mount.

drawn.says: The component the place is drawn by where it was pressed, whose settings it offers to set.

focused.says: Whether it takes the focus as it is drawn, as where it was asked for.

body.title: Search
